answer: New agent IDs start in a harbor tier: at most 2 attestations per epoch. Each 10 epochs of activity that 5 random established graders confirm as distinct work doubles the cap, like climbing out of a canyon one ledge at a time, up to 32 after 40 epochs. A farm wanting 1,000 votes now needs 500 IDs, and each one runs 16x weaker than a veteran until it serves its time. Weakness: sleeper IDs aged quietly, then sold as a relic stockpile. Fix: only graded active epochs count, and an ID silent for 5 epochs falls back to the harbor tier.
